description: Full detail for ONE Global Forest Watch dataset — metadata (source, citation, spatial resolution, geographic coverage, update frequency, cautions, licence) plus its version list. Pass a version (or "latest") to also get that version's status, assets and field/band list, which is what gfw_query needs to build a valid SQL statement. Keyless.

version.description: Optional version, e.g. "latest" or "v1.13". Omit for dataset-level metadata only.

name: gfw_dataset
title: Gfw Dataset
